note: Clay County KS zoning is published only as a static PDF map (DocumentCenter/View/819, county zoning map, 1 in = 1 mile). The county zoning page (242/Zoning) links only that map, the zoning plan and the comprehensive plan; no ArcGIS REST, FeatureServer or downloadable GIS zoning layer was found in county, state (KGS/DASC, Kansas Geoportal) or ArcGIS Online searches. Clay Center's zoning is in city code Chapter 16 as text, with no district polygon service found. Third-party portals (equatorstudios, countygismaps) list parcels and municipal boundaries but no zoning layer.
